e=$(grep -m1 '^model:' "$HOME/.claude/agents/executor.md" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^model:[[:space:]]*//'); s=$(grep -m1 '^model:' "$HOME/.claude/agents/scout.md" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^model:[[:space:]]*//'); [ -n "$e" ] && echo "[tier] worker=$e recon=${s:-?} — dispatch: recon→scout · slices→executor · claims→verifier · trivial→inline"; true
